_about: The records of the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland: the Acts and Proceedings from 1560 to 1618, the 'Booke of the Universall Kirk', in the Bannatyne Club's edition, printed under the superintendence of its President, Thomas Thomson (Edinburgh, 1839-1845, 3 parts); Alexander Peterkin's Records of the Kirk of Scotland, the Assemblies from 1638 (Edinburgh, 1838, vol. 1, the only one published); and the Church Law Society's Acts of the General Assembly 1638-1842 (Edinburgh, 1843). Records, not authored works: the name check looks for 'General Assembly'. Much of 1560-1618 is in older Scots spelling, so the OCR's share of common English words runs low. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

booke-universall-kirk-1: Acts and Proceedings of the General Assemblies of the Kirk of Scotland, part 1, 1560-1577 (Edinburgh: Bannatyne Club, 1839)
booke-universall-kirk-2: Acts and Proceedings of the General Assemblies of the Kirk of Scotland, part 2, 1578-1592 (Edinburgh: Bannatyne Club, 1840)
booke-universall-kirk-3: Acts and Proceedings of the General Assemblies of the Kirk of Scotland, part 3, 1593-1618 (Edinburgh: Bannatyne Club, 1845)
peterkin-records-of-the-kirk-1: Records of the Kirk of Scotland, containing the Acts and Proceedings of the General Assemblies from 1638, ed. Alexander Peterkin, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: Sutherland, 1838)
acts-general-assembly-1638-1842: Acts of the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland, 1638-1842 (Edinburgh: Church Law Society, 1843)
